post.description: Walks the edges the ontology flags `impact: propagates` downstream from the repository, depth 1..4 (default 2). Each hit is scored min(1, 1/(1+hops) * tierWeight * pathBoost) - scoring version 1 - and the hits are ordered by score descending, hops ascending, node id ascending, at most `limit` (1..500, default 50) of them. Identical requests against an unchanged graph give identical bodies.
